The movie "Barb Wire" (1996) starred Pamela Anderson, not Tricia Helfer. Pamela Anderson is indeed Canadian-born (from British Columbia), but she is the one who played the lead role of Barb Wire.

Tricia Helfer is a Canadian-born actress, but she did not star in Barb Wire.
